summary: Max continuous driving time before a mandatory rest. Required within layover_config.
businessRules: After this much continuous driving, a layover_duration rest is inserted.

max_continuous_time defines: Define the maximum time, in seconds, that a driver can drive without taking a break. This field is mandatory when using the layover_config attribute. Please note that accumulation of driving time i…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.layover_config.layover_duration. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Values in seconds; must be non-negative. Zero means instantaneous.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: max_continuous_time 16200 (4.5h) triggers a rest on long routes.
Boundary: a route just under the limit takes no rest.
